description: This real-time telemetry dashboard is engineered to monitor astronauts' physiological parameters—like heart rate, SpO2, and radiation exposure—during deep space missions. Leveraging sophisticated algorithms, it analyzes anomalies and triggers instantaneous alerts for critical deviations. Our paramount objective is to deploy an intuitive UI that fortifies mission safety, endowing the crew with unparalleled precision and real-time medical insights.
summary: AstraVitals is an interactive, real-time biomedical telemetry dashboard designed to monitor critical astronaut health parameters during deep-space missions. Focusing on Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS), Intracranial Pressure (ICP) fluid shifts, and Acute Cosmic Radiation exposure, the platform simulates physiological anomalies before they become life-threatening. Built as a lightweight, browser-based command interface with a 3D reactive cranial bio-sphere and live P1/P2 intracranial waveforms, AstraVitals analyzes multi-vital deviations and triggers autonomous Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) countermeasure protocols. By translating complex aerospace medical data into clear, actionable alerts, AstraVitals empowers flight surgeons and crew members to detect microgravity-induced neurological and radiation risks early on long-duration lunar and Martian expeditions.
details:
How It Works: AstraVitals simulates and monitors critical astronaut physiological vitals in real time, specifically tracking Intracranial Pressure (ICP in mmHg), Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS) risk, Heart Rate (BPM), SpO2 saturation, and Acute Cosmic Radiation exposure (mSv). Users can adjust telemetry parameters manually or trigger emergency mission scenarios to observe real-time P1/P2 intracranial compliance waveform shifts and automated Red Alert diagnostics. When critical thresholds are breached, the system initiates an autonomous Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) countermeasure protocol to stabilize cephalad fluid shifts and normalize vitals.

Benefits & Intended Impact: During long-duration lunar and Martian transit beyond Earth's magnetosphere, delayed communication makes real-time Earth-based medical intervention impossible. AstraVitals provides an intuitive, zero-latency clinical decision-support interface that helps crew members identify invisible neurological and radiation hazards early, preventing permanent vision damage, cognitive impairment, and acute radiation sickness.

Tools, Coding Languages & Software Used: Developed as a lightweight, cross-platform client-side web application using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 Canvas for real-time medical ECG/ICP waveform rendering, and interactive 3D mathematical projection graphics. Hosted via GitHub Pages for instant global accessibility without heavy server overhead.

Creativity & Factors Considered: Rather than displaying static spreadsheets, we combined aerospace biomedical thresholds with a cursor-reactive 3D Cranial Bio-Sphere that visually shifts color and pulse frequency based on physiological stress. Our team factored in microgravity-induced fluid redistribution, non-invasive compliance waveform inversion (P2 > P1), and solar particle radiation spikes.

Super Intelligence (SI) Acknowledgment: Generative AI (Large Language Models) was utilized to assist in structuring the HTML/CSS/JavaScript simulation architecture, refining physiological waveform logic, and editing project documentation.
